mechanism_narrative: Sustained four-week upward trend in RETAIL_REC (from -22.4% to -13.3%) indicates recovery momentum in consumer mobility. This trend will continue over the next four weeks, producing net positive direction in RETAIL_REC relative to the baseline period.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 9.1 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days falls below the mean of the last 28 days, or the week-on-week improvement rate reverses for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility remains severely depressed (at -26.6%), constraining commuter access to retail districts. If TRANSIT does not improve by at least 5 percentage points in the next week, RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed below -10% over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -21.6% (no 5-point improvement from t-0w)
failure_condition: TRANSIT improves by 5+ percentage points in week t+1w AND RETAIL_REC subsequently rises above -8% in the following three weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Divergence between GROCERY_PHARM (stable at +9.1%) and RETAIL_REC (recovering at -13.3%) reflects consumer preference for essential shopping over discretionary retail. This behavioral split will persist, capping RETAIL_REC recovery to less than -5% over the next four weeks despite improving trend.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains above +8% while RETAIL_REC remains below -10%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -5% over the next 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM falls below +5%, indicating behavioral rebalancing.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has recovered to +5.6%, signaling outdoor activity preference and reduced infection risk perception. This confidence will spill over into retail-and-recreation venues over the next two weeks, driving RETAIL_REC toward -8% or better.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved 20 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS mobility falls below 0% in week t+1w, or RETAIL_REC fails to improve by 3+ percentage points over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of WORKPLACES recovery (-11.3%) and RESIDENTIAL normalization (+5.1%) indicates stabilization of work-from-home patterns. When WORKPLACES exceeds -10% AND RESIDENTIAL falls below +6%, commuting routines will anchor retail footfall, producing RETAIL_REC improvement to -8% or better over four weeks.
failure_condition: Either WORKPLACES falls below -12% or RESIDENTIAL rises above +7% in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC remains below -10% over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL elevation (+5.1%) combined with TRANSIT depression (-26.6%) indicates active mobility restrictions or public transport capacity limits. If TRANSIT does not recover to -20% or better within two weeks, policy constraints will prevent RETAIL_REC from exceeding -10% over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -20.6% (no 6-point improvement) AND RESIDENTIAL remains above +4%
failure_condition: TRANSIT improves to -20% or better within two weeks AND RETAIL_REC subsequently rises above -8% in weeks t+2w through t+4w.

mechanism_narrative: Four-week momentum in RETAIL_REC recovery (9.1 percentage point improvement) reflects seasonal or calendar-driven demand rebound. Absent external shocks, this momentum will sustain, producing RETAIL_REC in the range of -8% to -5% over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 9.1 points over four weeks at consistent rate
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines by more than 2 percentage points in any single week over the next four weeks, or the mean over the next 28 days falls below the mean of the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS recovery to +5.6% combined with WORKPLACES remaining depressed at -11.3% indicates substitution of outdoor leisure for workplace commuting. This behavioral shift will suppress RETAIL_REC recovery to below -10% over the next four weeks as consumers favor parks over indoor retail venues.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises above -8% in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC exceeds -8% over the next 28 days despite PARKS remaining above +4%.
